tokens.name: brand-pitch-green
tokens.usage: Brand Pitch Green. Fills, dark-mode accents, the app icon ground. Never as text on a light ground (2.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-green-dark
tokens.usage: Brand Green Dark, kept exact from the brand palette. For icons, focus rings and bold display text 19px+ (3:1 minimum) on surface in the light theme, where it measures 4.07:1. Not a body-text colour, and never drawn on top of another green.

tokens.name: brand-green-light
tokens.usage: Brand Green Light. Highlights and the dark-mode focus ring. Ink text on it (10.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand Ink. Dark-mode page ground; text on light grounds and on every green, amber or red fill.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything (Ink in dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, list containers, the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit above a card: menus, popovers, the team-sheet card, inputs in dark. Pair with shadow-2 in light.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets, above scrim.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the pitch strip, availability grid ground, input-group tracks, segmented-control tracks.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse chips and tooltips; text-inverse on it.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed wash for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select, toggle-track and secondary-button borders. 3:1+ on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-overlay, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, row meta, labels on all surfaces.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, helper text on all surfaces (4.7:1+ dark, 5.2:1+ light).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only (exempt from contrast, always paired with a disabled cursor/state).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected chips, active tab pip, the 'you' marker, team A in the fairness bar. on-accent text on it.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill, highlight and every hover/pressed green (6:1+).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Green links, 'View all', active nav labels on bg/surface/surface-raised. Light value deepens Green Dark to pass 4.5:1 at body size.

tokens.name: accent-icon
tokens.usage: Green icons and non-text marks (3:1+).

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected rows, 'you' row on leaderboards, available cells.

tokens.name: accent-on-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on accent-subtle.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Moments of delight: fairness sweet spot, first place, new personal best. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 2px. 3:1+ against every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: result-win
tokens.usage: Win fill (W chip, ✓). Always with the W letter and ✓ icon; on-result text.

tokens.name: result-win-text
tokens.usage: Win as text on surfaces.

tokens.name: result-loss
tokens.usage: Loss fill (L chip, ✗) and destructive fills. Always with the L letter and ✗ icon; on-result text (4.7:1).

tokens.name: result-loss-text
tokens.usage: Loss and error text on surfaces.

tokens.name: result-draw
tokens.usage: Draw fill (D chip, –). Shared with provisional, so always with a letter or label; on-result text.

tokens.name: result-draw-text
tokens.usage: Draw text on surfaces.

tokens.name: on-result
tokens.usage: Text on result-win, result-loss, result-draw, provisional and info fills.

tokens.name: result-win-subtle
tokens.usage: Win row/tile tint; result-win-text on it.

tokens.name: result-loss-subtle
tokens.usage: Loss and error tint; result-loss-text on it.

tokens.name: result-draw-subtle
tokens.usage: Draw and provisional tint; result-draw-text on it.

tokens.name: provisional
tokens.usage: Provisional rating badge fill. Always the '~' band or the PROV label, never a bare amber.

tokens.name: provisional-text
tokens.usage: Provisional labels as text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info fill: tips, 'syncing', notification dots that aren't urgent. on-result text.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info text and links inside notices.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Info banner ground; info-text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, delete confirmations; on-result text.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover; on-result text.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages, field errors.

tokens.name: team-a
tokens.usage: Team A side of the fairness meter, scoreboard and team column header. Always labelled with the team name.

tokens.name: team-b
tokens.usage: Team B side (a neutral, like a white kit). Always labelled with the team name.

tokens.name: on-team-a
tokens.usage: Text on team-a.

tokens.name: on-team-b
tokens.usage: Text on team-b.

tokens.name: bib
tokens.usage: Hi-vis bib orange: the bib flag fill, bib stat tiles. Always with the bib icon and the word BIBS — it sits near loss red and draw amber in hue, so never colour alone. on-bib text on it; 3:1+ as a mark on every ground.

tokens.name: bib-text
tokens.usage: Bib orange as text (“in bibs”) on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: bib-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the 'you're in bibs' banner; bib-text on it.

tokens.name: on-bib
tokens.usage: Text and stripes on the bib flag.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The LIVE dot and running-clock pip (always with the word LIVE).

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton block base.

tokens.name: skeleton-shine
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer highlight.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Rating line (3:1+ on surface).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headings, dialog titles, team names.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows above headings, state chips, BIBS flag. Uppercase.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: Live tracking score on phone. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mark the days you can make it.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, chart axes, badge text. Never for anything the user must act on.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge icon gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in chips.

tokens.usage: Gap inside rows, between chips.

tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, input padding-y.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), page gutter at 360px, button padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (web).

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus-ring corners on tight items, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, badges, availability cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: squad, match, team column, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), dialogs, phone hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, chips, segmented controls, the fairness bar.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the notifications panel, dragged player chips.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The fairness meter in its sweet spot (48–52%), the Lock teams button when ready, the watch goal ring.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle thumb.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tabs, chips, toasts in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, the fairness needle settling.

tokens.name: duration-celebrate
tokens.usage: Sweet-spot pulse, goal flash. Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-out

tokens.usage: Playful moments only: needle landing at 50/50, a goal tally ticking up.

tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target on web (desktop).

tokens.usage: Minimum touch target, phone and touch web.

tokens.usage: Live tracking primary actions (sweaty hands).

tokens.name: target-watch

tokens.usage: Mobile tab bar (plus safe area).

tokens.usage: Sticky headers, tab bar.
